about: One shared session in the lossless form of SHARING_40.md 19.4 (Ogg FLAC) as every SDK must write it. Input: test_signal(rate * seconds, rate, seed) of tools/sharing40.py (integer only; pcm_sha256 is SHA-256 of it as 16-bit little endian), serial and vendor fixed. Feed the samples to the SDK's encoder and muxer (a test seam for the serial and the vendor) and compare every segment file byte for byte; the concatenation decodes to the input exactly.
